summary: Retested quick print end-to-end after QuickPrintDialog lifecycle patch. Backend document generation and auth suites are green, print menu opens correctly, diagnosis/visit/invoice previews mostly resolve, but invoice (and occasionally visit) still intermittently opens QuickPrintDialog with blank state (no loading/preview/error), so issue is reduced but not fully fixed.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent blank dialog state after clicking invoice/visit print: quick-print-dialog opens but none of quick-print-loading, quick-print-preview, or quick-print-error are rendered.

integration_issues.issue: Flaky resolution: in 1/5 looped invoice attempts, dialog resolved to blank state instead of preview/error; violates expected deterministic transition within 20s.

action_items: Fix QuickPrintDialog race causing blank state: generateHtml currently reads payloadBuilderRef.current and returns empty early when ref not yet updated; ensure generate path always uses a valid payloadBuilder (fallback to latest prop) and shows explicit error when payload is missing.
Re-test invoice + visit print at least 10 sequential opens to confirm deterministic state transition (preview or error, never blank).
Keep current menu behavior as-is (it is stable in this retest).
critical_code_review_comments: Probable root cause of remaining flake: QuickPrintDialog.generateHtml() uses payloadBuilderRef.current; if ref lags prop update during open/reopen cycles, function exits early with empty return and no UI state (loading/error/preview).
No QuickPrintDialog/VehicleDetails undefined-variable runtime errors observed in this retest.
No failed /api/documents/generate responses observed during UI runs.
VehicleDetails.jsx is very large (~4599 lines), exceeding maintainability guidance; split print/dialog payload logic into focused hooks/modules to reduce lifecycle bugs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified after patch: print menu opens deterministically; backend generate/auth are green. Diagnosis preview resolved with required workshop fields. Invoice is still flaky: seen blank-state 1/5 loops (dialog open with no loading/preview/error). Visit print also showed one blank-state in an earlier run but passed in later stability run.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open vehicle details -> open print menu -> click invoice repeatedly. Observed intermittent state where quick-print-dialog opens with no loading/error/preview nodes. Likely RCA: payloadBuilderRef timing race in QuickPrintDialog; generateHtml relies on ref value and returns '' early when ref not set yet, without setting error/loading, producing blank UI. Mitigation: call current prop payloadBuilder directly (or keep ref but guard with fallback) and set explicit error when payloadBuilder is missing.
